# RSA signatures made with Homebrew OpenSSL 3 (openssl dgst -HASH -sign, with -sigopt
# rsa_padding_mode:pss -sigopt rsa_pss_saltlen:digest for PSS) from throwaway keys made for
# this file and then deleted; only the public halves are here. Each was checked with
# openssl dgst -verify. The 2049-bit key (bits = 1 mod 8: the PSS encoded message is a byte
# shorter than the modulus) was assembled from Python-made primes with openssl asn1parse.
# key BITS N E          starts a key; the lines after it use it
# SCHEME HASH MSG SIG   SCHEME = pkcs1 or pss (salt length = hash length, MGF1 with the same hash)
key 2048  010001
pkcs1 sha256 - 
pss sha256 616263 
pkcs1 sha384 616263 
pss sha384 54686520717569636b2062726f776e20666f78206a756d7073206f76657220746865206c617a7920646f67 
pkcs1 sha512 54686520717569636b2062726f776e20666f78206a756d7073206f76657220746865206c617a7920646f67 
pss sha512  
key 2049  010001
pkcs1 sha256 - 
pss sha256 616263 
pss sha384 54686520717569636b2062726f776e20666f78206a756d7073206f76657220746865206c617a7920646f67 
pss sha512
